name: PopNow
tagline: All-in-One AI Studio for Video, Images & Music
description:
PopNow is an all-in-one AI studio for video, image and music creation. It brings 193 AI models and 253 one-tap effects into one workspace.

PopNow Protect: failed or off-spec generations get a full credit refund; late jobs earn 50% bonus credits, and 100% if they take more than twice the guaranteed time; if you find a lower public standard price on Higgsfield, Runway or fal, the first verified report gets 2x the difference.

Billing is pay-per-run: the price is shown before you generate, there is no subscription, and credits never expire. The starter pack is $10 for 10,000 credits.

On prices checked November 13, 2026, popular models cost up to 28% less than Higgsfield Ultra, up to 64% less than the Runway API (Seedance 2.0 Mini at 720p for 5 seconds is $0.27 vs $0.75), and up to 65% less than fal.
